Name: WU-Beautiful Aideen-Seasonal characters and portraits-East Scarp
Author: xiaowugogo
Description:
已过时！她缺少花舞节，姜岛和魂灵节肖像，如果你愿意你可以为其增加节日肖像！

这是东斯卡普东悬崖的艾丁的四季行走图,和她的可选高清肖像美化

务必搭配尾号10731的现代的使用！

--------------------------------
高清肖像的安装方式（使用高清肖像一定要下载10731和999mod前置)
在Mods\Portraiture\Portraits,新建英文或者数字名字的文件夹,放入就行了
进游戏后对话按p，就显示了,按o锁定
-------------------------------
声明
四季艾登肖像的作者好像不上n网了,实在很喜欢她的四季艾登就给她画了行走图,如果作者本人觉得我侵权了,请私信我我会下架的
本人不擅长代码,如果有很严重的bug，可以在评论区说,我尽量去解决
Aideen HD portrait-Scale Up 2代码由[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182121522]Nextlifemk[/url]友情提供(*^_^*)，这款不需要10731和999，只需要Scale Up 2

-以下为机翻
Outdated! She lacks the portraits of the Flower Dance Festival, Ginger Island, and the Soul Festival，If you are willing, you can add holiday portraits to it!
Must end with mod 10731!
--------------------------------
High definition portrait installation method (to use high-definition portrait, you must download 10731 and 999)
Create a new folder with an English or numerical name in Mods\Portraiture\Portraits, and place it in
After entering the game, press' p 'to display the conversation, and press' o' to lock the conversation
-------------------------------
statement
It seems that the author of the Four Seasons Eden portrait is no longer online. If he really likes her, Four Seasons Aiden painted her a walking picture. If the author believes that I have infringed, please send me a private message and I will remove the mod
I am not good at coding. If there are serious bugs, you can say in the comment section and I will do my best to solve them
The code for Aideen HD portrait Scale Up 2 is kindly provided by Nextlifemk (* ^ _ ^ *)，This model does not require 10731 and 999, only Scale Up 2 is needed
